specs.title: Paystack charge at booking
specs.why: Taking payment at booking time is what makes deposits and no-show protection possible.
specs.scope: Initialize a transaction, redirect to checkout and verify on callback, with tenant subaccount splits.
specs.non_goals: Use `app/lib/payments/fake.ts` in tests. Live Paystack credentials must not be required for CI.
tasks: Add `app/lib/slot-hold.ts`: release held slots on failure
acceptance: A test-mode payment moves the booking to `confirmed`, verified by `pnpm test`
A failed payment releases the slot within 10 minutes
The subaccount split matches the configured percentage
No secret value appears in logs, verified by `pnpm test`
scope_paths: `__tests__/**` and `tests/**` for the tests that prove the criteria
`prisma/schema.prisma` and `prisma/migrations/**` when the work needs schema support
`docs/**` for documentation the change makes stale

specs.title: Paystack webhooks
specs.why: Payment state must converge even when the customer closes the tab, which only webhooks guarantee.
specs.scope: Handle charge.success, charge.failed and refund.processed with signature verification and idempotency.
tasks: Add `app/lib/idempotency.ts`: add the idempotency store with a 7-day TTL
Add `prisma/schema.prisma`: route unknown events to a dead letter table
acceptance: A replayed event produces no state change, verified by `pnpm test`
All three event types update booking and payment state
scope_paths: `__tests__/**` and `tests/**` for the tests that prove the criteria
`prisma/schema.prisma` and `prisma/migrations/**` when the work needs schema support
`docs/**` for documentation the change makes stale
